# Package core

<!-- Generated by `go run ./cmd/apidoc` — do not edit by hand. -->

Package core implements the ApiPilot wire contract in Go.

It mirrors ApiPilot.Core (C#) and @apipilot/core (TypeScript):
envelopes, error codes, pagination, validation field keys, origin,
fetch-metadata, cookie profiles, CSRF format/binding, correlation,
and content negotiation. All logic is framework-neutral and pinned
by the shared conformance vectors.

## func EncodeCsrfPayload

```go
func EncodeCsrfPayload(int64, string) string, error
```

EncodeCsrfPayload encodes payload parts into the pipe-delimited plaintext.
Returns an error on empty parts, delimiter inside parts, or non-integer time.

## func EvaluateContentNegotiation

```go
func EvaluateContentNegotiation(*string, string, ContentNegotiationOptions) NegotiationDecision
```

EvaluateContentNegotiation produces the full negotiation decision.
Mirrors ApiPilotContentNegotiationMiddleware.InvokeAsync:
 1. Accept check (only when header present) → 406
 2. Content-Type check only for body-carrying methods → 415
    Missing Content-Type on body-carrying method → reject unless
    AcceptMissingContentType.

## func EvaluateFetchMetadata

```go
func EvaluateFetchMetadata(*string, FetchMetadataOptions) FetchMetadataDecision
```

EvaluateFetchMetadata evaluates Sec-Fetch-Site / Sec-Fetch-Mode.
Mirrors FetchMetadataEvaluator (C#). Compat and Strict produce
IDENTICAL decisions — the profile distinction exists only for
startup validation. Off short-circuits to allow.

## func FromCode

```go
func FromCode(string) ApiErrorCode, error
```

FromCode normalizes a raw string into an ApiErrorCode: trims and
uppercases (invariant). Returns the canonical instance for standard
codes; a new instance (HTTP 500) for custom codes.
Returns an error when raw is empty or whitespace.

## func GenerateGUIDv7

```go
func GenerateGUIDv7() string
```

GenerateGUIDv7 generates a GUIDv7 correlation ID (RFC 9562, time-ordered).

## func IsAcceptHeaderAcceptable

```go
func IsAcceptHeaderAcceptable(*string, ContentNegotiationOptions) bool
```

IsAcceptHeaderAcceptable evaluates the Accept header.
Mirrors IsAcceptHeaderAcceptable:
  - missing/empty → accept
  - comma-split, trim, skip empty
  - media type = before first ';' (q= and params ignored)
  - "*/*" accepted iff AcceptWildcard (exact match)
  - otherwise case-insensitive membership
  - type wildcards like "application/*" are NOT honored

## func IsContentTypeAcceptable

```go
func IsContentTypeAcceptable(string, ContentNegotiationOptions) bool
```

IsContentTypeAcceptable checks a single Content-Type header value.

## func NormalizeFieldKey

```go
func NormalizeFieldKey(string) string
```

NormalizeFieldKey normalizes a raw field key to canonical camelCase form:
strips a single leading "$." JSONPath prefix, camelCases each
dot-separated segment, preserves "[i]" bracket indices verbatim.
Mirrors FieldKeyNormalizer (C#).

## func OriginMatches

```go
func OriginMatches(string) bool
```

OriginMatches compares two origin strings under the given mode.
Modes: "exact", "anyPortSameHost", "sameSite" (always false — not implemented).

## func ParseSortDirection


ParseSortDirection is the default direction parser: asc/desc case-insensitive, trimmed.

## func ResolveCorrelationID

```go
func ResolveCorrelationID(*string, CorrelationOptions, bool) CorrelationDecision
```

ResolveCorrelationID decides the effective correlation ID for a request.
Mirrors CorrelationMiddleware:
  - absent header → generate
  - present + pattern match → use incoming
  - present + no match → policy: replace→generate, reject→reject, useAsIs→use+warn


else NormalizeFieldKey.

## func TryDecodeCsrfPayload

```go
func TryDecodeCsrfPayload(string) CsrfPayloadParts, bool
```

TryDecodeCsrfPayload decodes a pipe-delimited payload.
Returns (parts, true) or (zero, false). Deliberately lenient — only
structure (3 non-empty parts, integer time in range) is checked.
Mirrors CsrfTokenFormat.TryDecode.


TryFromCode returns the canonical code for a wire string, or false.

## func TryParseOrigin

```go
func TryParseOrigin(string) OriginParts, bool
```

TryParseOrigin parses an origin string into normalized parts.
Returns (parts, true) or (zero, false). Never panics on malformed input.
Mirrors OriginValidator (C#).

## func ValidateCookieProfile

```go
func ValidateCookieProfile(CookieProfile, CookieProfileRole) []string
```

ValidateCookieProfile validates a cookie profile. Returns violation codes
(empty slice = valid). Mirrors CookieProfileOptionsValidator +
HostPrefixValidator (C#).
